# שָׁרְט

```
╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                      ║
║    شَرْط ←→ שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                      ║
║    condition / incision              ║
║    stipulation / scratch             ║
║                                      ║
║    ش ↔ ש                             ║
║    ר ↔ ر                             ║
║    ט ↔ ط                             ║
║                                      ║
║    root cuts both ways               ║
║                                      ║
║    to make terms                     ║
║    is to make marks                  ║
║                                      ║
║    every contract                    ║
║    a wound agreed upon               ║
║                                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
```

*the shared semitic root speaks*

שׁ-ר-ט : to scratch, to incise, to mark skin
ش-ر-ط : to stipulate, to condition, to require

the covenant written in flesh
the agreement that leaves a trace

```
awaiting.condition" █
```
